title: COSIS Overlay: Using SI Agent Systems (SI Agents) – Multi-Agent
primary_risks: Inter-agent lateral movement and privilege escalation when a subagent is compromised via untrusted input
Agent reward hacking where worker agents mutate shared verification gates or orchestrator configs
Cross-agent state contamination or race conditions across shared workspaces and sessions
Cascading retry storms and unbounded fan-out across cooperative agent topologies

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Authenticate and scope each agent role and shard independently using audience-restricted credentials rather than sharing a single omnipotent credential across the swarm.

parameter_assignments.ia-09_odp.01: per-shard / per-role audience-scoped credentials with zero cross-agent bearer token forwarding

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify read-only researcher subagents and domain shards do not possess admin shard credentials.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Restrict write access to orchestrator policies, auth modules, and contract test suites strictly to the trusted host chassis; forbid worker agents from modifying their own evaluators.

parameter_assignments.ac-06.01_odp.01: Golden Template chassis (auth, server, contract gates, validator) locked :ro with SHA-256 tamper detection

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Simulate worker subagent mutating a locked gate file; verify TamperDetectionError aborts and restores pristine bytes.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Enforce typed message schemas (outputSchema / structuredContent) and stateless sessionless boundaries (SEP-2567) across inter-agent handoffs so unvalidated blobs and globals never cross agents.

parameter_assignments.ac-04_odp.01: JSON Schema 2020-12 typed handoffs + isolated branch/worktree workspaces per concurrent writer agent

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify every inter-agent tool boundary publishes a non-null outputSchema and holds zero mutable module globals.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Perform cryptographic SHA-256 integrity checks across locked chassis files before and after every delegated subagent turn or self-healing retry.

parameter_assignments.si-07.01_odp.01: pre-turn and post-turn SHA-256 workspace digest verification with fail-closed abort

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm post-turn integrity check catches both file modification and unauthorized file creation in locked directories.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Correlate audit logs across orchestrator and subagent invocations with trace/request identifiers to reconstruct multi-agent causal chains and detect cascade loops.

parameter_assignments.au-06_odp.01: structured JSON stderr telemetry with step/retry counters and RFC 9110 correlation header propagation

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify multi-stage orchestrator runs record per-iteration gate status and correlation metadata cleanly.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Bound multi-agent retry counts (e.g., max 3 self-healing iterations), per-profile tool counts (<= 15), and response byte budgets to prevent cascading amplification.

parameter_assignments.sc-05_odp.01: max 3 self-healing retries + <= 15 active tools per agent role + 32 KiB response cap

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm persistent validation failure terminates deterministically at the configured retry cap.
